title.en: The End of the War in Heaven

excerpt.zh:

title.en: The End of the War in Heaven

texts.zh:
在经历漫长而残酷的争斗后，天堂之战以双方僵持不下的局面而告终。[WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName]与[WarInHeavenFETwo.GetName]已经签署了停火协议，将舰队撤回了各自边境。

目前星系中维系着脆弱的和平，但这次休战能持续多久呢？
texts.en:
After a long and fierce conflict, the War in Heaven has ended with neither side able to achieve dominance over the other. The [WarInHeavenFEOne.GetName] and [WarInHeavenFETwo.GetName] have signed a ceasefire and withdrawn their fleets back to their own borders. 

For now, an uneasy peace reigns over the galaxy, but how long can this truce last?
